verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst lets business users ask natural-language questions about their data and get direct answers without writing SQL. Cortex AI Functions run LLM-powered analytics on text and images inside Snowflake, and the homepage promotes "Ask anything with Snowflake CoWork." Together these cover the core of getting AI-generated insights from your data in the product. missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (beyond Q&A and preview cost-anomaly monitors), detailed docs on how insights are presented in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
